name: Default EBS Encryption Disable
description: Accounts can require that every new EBS disk is encrypted. An attacker who turns that default off in a region does not decrypt old disks; they make new ones and snapshots readable without KMS. Later, volumes they create or copy are easier to steal or share. This is a setup step, not the theft itself. The follow-on is usually a snapshot copy or a public share. Default encryption should only change through a reviewed infrastructure pipeline.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
